title: Monster Hunter 3G HD Ver.
name_bilingual: 弩后坐力最小 / Minimum Bowgun Recoil
install_folder: MH3G HD JP v96 - Static 49 - Minimum Bowgun Recoil

preimages.meaning: 中文：强制效果 ID 0x2F 的 PPC 直接检查返回真。 / English: Force the direct PPC check for effect ID 0x2F to return true.
中文：强制效果 ID 0x2F 的 PPC 直接检查返回真。 / English: Force the direct PPC check for effect ID 0x2F to return true.

anchors.meaning: 中文：调用前把效果 ID 0x2F 放入 PPC 参数 r4。 / English: Loads effect ID 0x2F into PPC argument r4 before the call.
中文：调用前把效果 ID 0x2F 放入 PPC 参数 r4。 / English: Loads effect ID 0x2F into PPC argument r4 before the call.

known_risks: 中文：通过强制 JP v96 中该效果 ID 的全部直接检查来激活语义；PPC 编译器复制/合并的路径数量与 3DS ARM 不完全相同，需要实机逐场景验证。 / English: Activates the semantic effect by forcing every direct JP-v96 check for its effect ID; PPC compiler duplication/consolidation differs from the 3DS ARM build and requires gameplay verification across contexts.
license: MIT for repository-authored metadata and patch source; no game assets included.
summary: 中文：把轻/重弩射击后的后坐力压到原生支持的最小档，缩短枪口上扬和开火后恢复时间。 状态：Runtime Experimental，默认关闭。 / English: Reduces Light/Heavy Bowgun firing recoil to the lowest native level, shortening muzzle rise and post-shot recovery. Status: Runtime Experimental; disabled by default.
